original_value: In recent years, the research of artificial neural networks based on fractional calculus has attracted much attention. In this paper, we proposed a fractional-order deep backpropagation (BP) neural network model with L2 regularization. The proposed network was optimized by the fractional gradient descent method with Caputo derivative. We also illustrated the necessary conditions for the convergence of the proposed network. The influence of L2 regularization on the convergence was analyzed with the fractional-order variational method. The experiments have been performed on the MNIST dataset to demonstrate that the proposed network was deterministically convergent and can effectively avoid overfitting.

result.paraphrase: In recent years, artificial neural network research based on fractional calculus has drawn considerable attention. In this paper, we propose an L2-regularized fractional-order deep backpropagation (BP) neural network model. The network is optimized using a fractional gradient descent method with the Caputo derivative. We also present the necessary conditions for convergence of the proposed network. Using the fractional-order variational method, we analyze how L2 regularization affects convergence. Experiments on the MNIST dataset show that the proposed network converges deterministically and can effectively avoid overfitting.
